card.name: Concentrate on, bother with, set about
card.fires_on: The word "on" after "concentrate", or verbs like "concentrated", "bother" and "set about" that expect a focus or target next. Found in general narrative web text.

modes.label: concentrate on
modes.description: The word "on" (or "concentrated") right after a form of "concentrate", before the thing being focused on.
modes.example: so he could concentrate<< on>> his presentations.

modes.label: bother / set about
modes.description: Verbs of taking trouble or starting a task, just before "about" or "with".
modes.example: He was also planning an invasion of Korea, so he really didn’t want to<< bother>> with these troublesome missionaries.

card.writes: Little clear meaning; the promoted tokens are scattered, though some hint at devote and bother.
card.plain: It fires on phrases about focusing on or bothering with something, mostly "concentrate on".
